name: Self-Directed Queries Complexity / Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: For finite concept classes, $\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Lemma 7 of Doliwa--Fan--Simon--Zilles (attributed there to Kuhlmann) gives $\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal C)\leq\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal C)$ for every concept class.  Since $\mathrm{SDC}$ is monotone under subclasses, their Lemmas 3--4 yield $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H)=\max_{\mathcal C\subseteq\mathcal H}\mathrm{TS}_{\min}(\mathcal C)\leq\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal H)$.
witness_verification: For any fixed $d\ge3$, Ben-David--Eiron's Lemma 1 gives $\mathrm{SDC}(\mathcal C_n^d)\ge n$ while $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal C_n^d)=d$. Hu--Wu--Li--Wang's explicit quadratic VC-to-RTD bound gives $\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal C_n^d)\le39.3752d^2-3.6330d$, independently of $n$. Thus $\mathrm{SDC}/\mathrm{RTD}$ is unbounded along this family.
